provider: Illustrative mapping prepared by the gateway operator, Andrei Nicolae Besleaga (andrei.besleaga@ieee.org), from the reporting subject's own published 2025 Social & Environmental Impact Fact Sheet (inventories prepared by Watershed); NOT published, reviewed, authorized, or endorsed by the reporting subject.
